title: Thigh Self-Massage
summary: The palms make long strokes and gentle circles over the front and outer thigh.
goal: Warm the thigh muscles gently after sitting or activity.
startingPosition: Sit stably with the leg relaxed.
instructions: Place the palms above the knee.
Do not press the knee joint or groin.
direction: From above the knee upward over the thigh.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
